extracted.intended_audience: researchers, university administrators, policy analysts, and others tracking NSF grant awards in mathematical and physical sciences
extracted.subtask_description: A printed/compiled listing of National Science Foundation grants and awards in the mathematical and physical sciences, showing awardee (PI), project title/topic, program code, award duration, dollar amount, and occasional award type (conference, travel, postdoctoral fellowship, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Principal Investigator / Awardee name
rubrics_metrics.description: The listing identifies the lead investigator(s) or awardee (e.g., 'KRA, IRWIN, MASKIT, BERNARD, AND LAUFER, HENRY', 'GROMOLL, DETLEF, AND CHEEGER, JEFF').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to attribute the award and locate researchers; appears as person or persons associated with the project entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project title / research topic
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry gives a concise project title or topical description (e.g., 'DEFORMATION OF COMPLEX STRUCTURES', 'DIFFERENTIAL GEOMETRY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves to indicate the scientific focus or scope of the funded work; sometimes includes parenthetical discipline labels (MATHEMATICS, MATHEMATICAL SCIENCES, PHYSICS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program code / grant identifier
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries include program/grant codes and identifiers such as '(MCS-8102621 A01)', '(PHY-8010689 A04)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides administrative classification and a unique identifier for the award; useful for searching NSF records and tracking award history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discipline / program label
rubrics_metrics.description: A discipline or program label accompanies many entries (examples: '(MATHEMATICS)', '(MATHEMATICAL SCIENCES)', '(PHYSICS)', '(ASTROPHYSICS)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classifies the award within NSF organizational/disciplinary categories; helps readers understand field-level distribution of funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award duration (months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Most entries state a period in months (e.g., '12 MONTHS', '24 MONTHS', '6 MONTHS').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the funded project period/term length; shown consistently alongside amounts in the listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount (dollars)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry lists the dollar amount of the award (e.g., '$75,100', '$8,000', '$29,000').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the funding level granted; some entries show multiple line items or supplements (e.g., A02, A03) with separate amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award type / special designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Some entries specify award type or special notes such as 'TRAVEL AWARD', 'CONFERENCE', 'INDIVIDUAL AWARD', 'POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCH FELLOWSHIP', or group travel for participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between research grants, travel grants, conference support, fellowships, and institutional awards; often accompanied by conference location and dates when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution / organizational affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards are grouped under institutional headings (e.g., 'SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY', 'DUKE UNIVERSITY', 'UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA, BERKELEY').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the recipient organization or host institution for the grant; useful for institution-level funding summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference/travel details (location and dates)
rubrics_metrics.description: When the award is for a conference or travel, entries often include location and dates (e.g., 'BRAUNLAGE, WEST GERMANY - JULY 26, TO AUGUST 7, 1982', 'RALEIGH, NORTH CAROLINA; APRIL 26-29, 1982').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides logistical details tied to the award; helpful to identify the event supported and timing.
